Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu

Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(MASS)
library(gridExtra)
```
Set Experiment name
```{r}
# Define the active experiment name
experiment_name <- "DAM0"
```
Load in the hourly activity file for the active DAM experiment:
```{r,define experiment}
# Specify the CSV file name using the experiment name
activity <- read.csv(paste("output/", experiment_name, "_hour.csv", sep = ""))
```
Filtering only ages 4-7 days.
```{r,filter ages}
activity<-activity%>%filter(AgeD>="4"&AgeD<=7)
```
Identify variables in the experiment that differ (Geno or Treatment) and group by these variables for summaries.
```{r,identify variables that differ and summarize}
# Reorder levels of Geno
activity$Geno <- reorder(activity$Geno, -as.numeric(activity$Geno == "CS"))

# Reorder levels of treatAdult
activity$treatAdult <- reorder(activity$treatAdult, -as.numeric(activity$treatAdult == "Ctrl"))

# Reorder levels of treatLarvae
activity$treatLarvae <- reorder(activity$treatLarvae, -as.numeric(activity$treatLarvae == "Ctrl"))


# Create a list of variable combinations to check
variable_combinations_to_check <- expand.grid(
  treatLarvae = unique(activity$treatLarvae),
  treatAdult = unique(activity$treatAdult),
  Geno = unique(activity$Geno)
)

# Initialize an empty list to store results
variable_summaries <- list()

# Loop through each variable combination
for (i in 1:nrow(variable_combinations_to_check)) {
  combination <- variable_combinations_to_check[i, ]
  
  # Filter the data for the current combination
  filtered_data <- activity %>%
    filter(
      treatLarvae %in% combination$treatLarvae,
      treatAdult %in% combination$treatAdult,
      Geno %in% combination$Geno
    )
  
  # Check if the filtered data has more than one level
  if (nrow(distinct(filtered_data)) > 1) {
    # Calculate the summary data for the combination
    variable_summary <- filtered_data %>%
      group_by(treatLarvae, treatAdult, Geno, Time, Sex) %>%
      summarise(
        Time = first(Time),
        variable_mean = mean(Summary_Ct),
        variable_sd = sd(Summary_Ct)
      )
    
    # Append the variable summary to the list
    variable_summaries[[paste(
      combination$treatLarvae,
      combination$treatAdult,
      combination$Geno,
      sep = "_"
    )]] <- variable_summary
  }
}

# Combine all variable summaries into a single dataframe
avg_counts_by_variable <- bind_rows(variable_summaries)
```
Create summary data across days by tube.
```{r,summarize across days}
avg_counts_by_tube <- activity %>%
  group_by(Monitor,Tube,Time) %>%
  summarise(Experiment=Experiment,
            Geno=Geno,
            Sex=Sex,
            Time=Time,
            treatLarvae=treatLarvae,
            treatAdult=treatAdult,
            tube_mean = mean(Summary_Ct), tube_sd = sd(Summary_Ct)
            )
avg_counts_by_tube<-bind_rows(unclass(distinct(avg_counts_by_tube)))
```
Plotting activity per individual tube by sex
```{r}
# Define the file path for saving the plot
plot_file <- file.path("plots", paste(experiment_name, " all tubes by sex.png", sep = ""))

# Create the ggplot
ggplot(avg_counts_by_tube, aes(x = Time, y = tube_mean, color = Sex, fill = Sex, 
                       group = interaction(Tube, Monitor))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Hour", 
    y = "Mean Count", 
    title = paste(experiment_name, "All Tubes by variable"),
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 350) +
  facet_wrap(~ Geno + treatAdult + treatLarvae)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())  # Remove x-axis labels

# Save the ggplot as a PNG file with specified dimensions
ggsave(plot_file, width = 12, height = 6, bg = "white", dpi = 300)

```
Plotting the means by variable combinations
```{r}
# Define the file path for saving the plot
plot_file <- file.path("plots", paste(experiment_name, " mean activity by variables.png", sep = ""))

# Create the ggplot
ggplot(avg_counts_by_variable, aes(x = Time, y = variable_mean, 
                                   color = Sex, fill = Sex, 
                group = interaction(treatLarvae, treatAdult, Geno))) +
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +
annotate("rect", xmin = "00:00", xmax = "09:00", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "gray", alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = "21:00", xmax = "23:59", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "gray", alpha = 0.3) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = "01:30", xmax = "02:30", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = "02:00", y = Inf,
           label = "Midnight Snack", vjust = 13, color = "black", size = 4)+
      annotate("rect", xmin = "07:30", xmax = "08:30", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "lightpink", alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = "08:00", y = Inf,
           label = "Morning Anxiety", vjust = 3, color = "black", size = 4)+
        annotate("rect", xmin = "11:30", xmax = "12:30", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = "12:00", y = Inf,
           label = "Early Siesta", vjust = 13, color = "black", size = 4)+
        annotate("rect", xmin = "20:30", xmax = "21:30", ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "violet", alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = "21:00", y = Inf,
           label = "Evening Peak", vjust = 3, color = "black", size = 4)+
  geom_point(aes(group=interaction(treatLarvae,treatAdult))) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Geno)) +
  labs(x = "Hour", 
       y = "Mean Counts per Hour", 
       title = paste(experiment_name, "activity by variable"),
       ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "purple", "F" = "orange")) +
  theme_classic() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+    
  ylim(0, 350) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))  # Rotate x-axis labels 45deg

# Save the ggplot as a PNG file with specified dimensions
ggsave(plot_file, width = 12, height = 6, bg = "white", dpi = 300)
```
